name: PermissionGroup - Default (seed v1)
description: A permission group: a rank (Default and the premium ranks) or a staff role. Members get the group's permission grants and its chat colours, salary and bonus multipliers and teleport fees. Players join groups from their admin page or in game; add the group's permission nodes with the Permission grant form.

steps.description: Name the group, place it in the inheritance chain and say whether it is a premium rank.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Shown in the Player manager, on admin pages and in the {group} placeholder. The group named Default is special: every new account joins it and players without a premium rank use its colours, so don't rename it.

fields.label: Weight
fields.description: Priority among a player's groups: higher weight is checked first for permissions, teleport fees and game-setting overrides, and the highest-weight premium rank is the one shown. The current ranks use 0 (Default) to 40 (Staff).

fields.label: Inherits from
fields.description: Members also get every grant of this group and of its own parents, checked after this group's own. One parent only, and never this group itself or one of its children. Premium ranks inherit from Default.

fields.label: Premium rank
fields.description: A paid rank such as Noble or Royal. A player holds one rank at a time, Default or one premium rank: giving one replaces the other, and removing it puts the player back on Default. Also shows the title bonus multipliers under Salary and bonuses.

steps.description: How members look in chat and the tab list. Used for a player's premium rank, or the Default group's for players without one; owner and staff use fixed colours. Enter Minecraft & codes only, such as &e or &6&l.

fields.label: Chat colour
fields.description: Colours the title, the rank name and the player's name in the chat line. Empty = the Default group's colour, then the plugin's own default.

fields.label: Chat bracket colour
fields.description: Colours the -{ }- brackets around the title in the chat line. Empty = the Default group's colour, then the plugin's own default.

fields.label: Tab-list colour
fields.description: Colour of the player's name in the tab list and above their head. Only the 16 named colours work there: a hex colour becomes the nearest one, and bold or italic is ignored.

fields.label: Chat prefix
fields.description: Text meant to appear before members' names in chat. Stored but not shown in game yet: the chat line is built from the title and the colours above.

fields.label: Chat suffix
fields.description: Text meant to appear after members' names in chat. Stored but not shown in game yet.

steps.description: Multipliers on what members earn. Each is multiplied over all of a player's active groups and their personal multiplier, so 1 means no change.

fields.label: Salary multiplier
fields.description: Scales members' hourly salary (their title's salary) and the coin bonus for reaching a new title. 1.1 = 10% more. Can't be negative.

fields.label: Title gem bonus multiplier
fields.description: Scales the one-time gem bonus a member gets on reaching a new title. 1 = unchanged; can't be negative. Only shown for premium ranks.

fields.label: Title XP bonus multiplier
fields.description: Scales the one-time XP bonus a member gets on reaching a new title; the extra XP can carry them into the next title. 1 = unchanged; can't be negative. Only shown for premium ranks.

steps.description: Fee and cooldown for /tpa and /tpahere, paid by the player who asks. A player's groups are checked in order (a group before the groups it inherits from, otherwise highest weight first); the first group that sets a price wins, and the cooldown is looked up the same way on its own. Set nowhere = the server's defaults.

fields.label: Price
fields.description: None = this group sets no price (the server's request fee applies, 0 by default, unless another group sets one). Fixed = the amounts below. Multiplier = the server's request fee times the multiplier.

fields.label: Price multiplier
fields.description: Factor on the server's request fee: 0.5 = half, 0 = free. 0 to 1000, rounded to whole coins.

fields.label: Coins
fields.description: Fixed price in coins. Empty = 0.

fields.label: Gems
fields.description: Fixed price in gems. Empty = 0.

fields.label: XP
fields.description: Fixed price in experience points. Empty = 0. Paying XP can lower the player's title.

fields.label: Cooldown (seconds)
fields.description: How long the player must wait after a request teleport (applies to the player who moved) before teleporting again; replaces the server's teleport cooldown (30 s in the default config). 0 to 86400. Empty = this group sets none.

steps.description: Fee and cooldown for /warp and the teleport menu. A player's groups are checked in order (a group before the groups it inherits from, otherwise highest weight first); the first group that sets a price wins, and the cooldown is looked up the same way on its own.

fields.label: Price
fields.description: None = this group sets no price (the destination's own gem price applies unless another group sets one). Fixed = the amounts below instead. Multiplier = the destination's gem price times the multiplier.

fields.label: Price multiplier
fields.description: Factor on the destination's gem price: 0.5 = half, 0 = free. 0 to 1000, rounded half up.

fields.label: Coins
fields.description: Fixed price in coins, replacing the destination's price. Empty = 0.

fields.label: Gems
fields.description: Fixed price in gems, replacing the destination's price. Empty = 0.

fields.label: XP
fields.description: Fixed price in experience points, replacing the destination's price. Empty = 0. Paying XP can lower the player's title.

fields.label: Cooldown (seconds)
fields.description: How long the player must wait after a warp before teleporting again; replaces the server's teleport cooldown (30 s in the default config). 0 to 86400. Empty = this group sets none.

steps.description: Fee and cooldown for /spawn, which is free unless a group sets a price. A player's groups are checked in order (a group before the groups it inherits from, otherwise highest weight first); the first group that sets a price wins, and the cooldown is looked up the same way on its own.

fields.label: Price
fields.description: None = this group sets no price (free unless another group sets one). Fixed = the amounts below. There is no multiplier: /spawn has no default price to multiply.

fields.label: Coins
fields.description: Fixed price in coins. Empty = 0.

fields.label: Gems
fields.description: Fixed price in gems. Empty = 0.

fields.label: XP
fields.description: Fixed price in experience points. Empty = 0. Paying XP can lower the player's title.

fields.label: Cooldown (seconds)
fields.description: How long the player must wait after a /spawn before teleporting again; replaces the server's teleport cooldown (30 s in the default config). 0 to 86400. Empty = this group sets none.
